req.title: Task title accepts unicode
req.statement: The system shall accept task titles containing UTF-8 characters and return them intact.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-031 requires that task titles containing UTF-8 characters are accepted and returned intact. Three test cases are designed: (1) a positive EP test sending a multi-script Unicode title and asserting the exact round-trip value in the 201 response body; (2) a boundary BVA test sending a Unicode title at exactly the max_length=100 character boundary (using multi-byte CJK characters that are each 1 code-point but >1 byte) and asserting 201 + exact title echo; (3) a negative NEG test sending a Unicode title that exceeds max_length=100 characters and asserting exactly 422 (Pydantic validation error). Together these cover the EP partition of valid Unicode, the BVA boundary at 100 code-points, and the NEG path beyond 100 code-points. All assertions use exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_unicode_title_roundtrip_positive
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: POST /tasks/ with a title containing Latin, CJK, Arabic, emoji, and combining characters
expected: response JSON field 'title' equals the submitted Unicode string exactly
response JSON field 'id' is an integer
trace: R-TASK-031: system shall accept UTF-8 titles and return them intact
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

unicode_title = u"Caf\u00e9 \u4e2d\u6587 \u0645\u0631\u062d\u0628\u0627 \U0001f600 e\u0301"

def test_unicode_title_roundtrip_positive():
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": unicode_title, "description": None, "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == unicode_title
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert "created_at" in body
